releases.notes:
# Minecraft
Upgrade Minecraft version to 26.3 .

# Data-driven
## Item
1. Add compostable component and template. (’minecraft:compostable‘, 'compostable)
2. Add display name component and template. ('minecraft:display_name', 'display_name')
3. Add fire resistance component and template. ('minecraft:fire_resistant',	'fire_resistant')
4. Add enchantable component and template. ('minecraft:enchantable', 'enchantable')
5. Add cooldown component and template. ('minecraft:cooldown', 'cooldown')

## Block
1. Add friction component and template. ('minecraft:friction', 'friction')
2. Add replaceable component and template. ('minecraft:replaceable', 'replaceable')

## Entity
1. Add fire immune component and template. ('minecraft:fire_immune', 'fire_immune')
2. Add health component and template. ('minecraft:health', 'health')
3. Add movement component and template. ('minecraft:movement', 'movement' / 'movement_speed')
4. Add knockback resistance component and template. ('minecraft:knockback_resistance', 'knockback_resistance')

releases.notes:
# Performance improves
Let events won't be triggered when no listeners requested the event.

# Scripting
Use 'Cancelable' and 'NoCancelable' to prevent calling the request methods with the suffix 'Nr'.

# Molang
Basic molang parsing and translating.

# Minecraft
Update to '1.21.11' version.

# Tech details
Add specified type of identity in metadata.\
Make more generic type to the event type system for more clearing specify the next event type.\
More DSL supporting.\
Ordering templates orders and components orders to make more readable and maintainable.\

# Bug fixes
Fix wrong effective blocks group in ConiumItemPickaxeTemplate.\

releases.notes:
# Conium script
## Event types
Add events support: 
1. 'BREAKING_BLOCK'
2. 'BROKEN_BLOCK'
3. 'ENTITY_DAMAGE'
4. 'ENTITY_DAMAGED'
5. 'ENTITY_DIE'
6. 'ENTITY_DEAD'.
7. 'ENTITY_TICK'
8. 'ENTITY_TICKED'
9. 'ITEM_USED_ON_BLOCK'
10. 'SERVER_TICK_TAIL'
11. 'FLUID_SCHEDULE_TICK'
12. 'FLUID_SCHEDULE_TICKED'
13. 'BLOCK_SCHEDULE_TICK'
14. 'BLOCK_SCHEDULE_TICKED'
15. 'SHULKER_BOX_OPENING'
16. 'SHULKER_BOX_OPENED'
17. 'SHULKER_BOX_CLOSING'
18. 'SHULKER_BOX_CLOSED'
19. 'CHEST_OPENING'
20. 'CHEST_OPENED'
21. 'CHEST_CLOSING'
22. 'CHEST_CLOSED'
23. 'TRAPPED_CHEST_OPENING'
24. 'TRAPPED_CHEST_OPENED'
25. 'TRAPPED_CHEST_CLOSING'
36. 'TRAPPED_CHEST_CLOSED'

## Event context
1. The 'identity' of event context that input to 'arising' and 'presaging' have actual type now. 
2. Add more dynamic args transformer and more arg types
3. Add method 'preRequest' in 'ConiumEventContextBuilder', used to make 'presage' trigger.
4. Methods 'request' in 'ConiumEventContextBuilder' can input two lambdas now, first is 'arise', seconds is 'presage'.
5. Add 'target' and 'targetTo' method in 'ConiumEventContext' used to filter the identity to trigger context.

## Data driven interactions
See the samples, the 'glint' key in [data define](https://github.com/cao-awa/Conium/blob/main/sample/datapacks/tests/data/awa/item/conium.json) and [interaction.kts](https://github.com/cao-awa/Conium/blob/main/sample/datapacks/tests/data/awa/script/interaction.kts) script.

This sample let an item change glint status in hand, when player is creative mode, use the item on block will make this item be glint, otherwise then be not glint.

# Data driven
Supported block templates: 
1. 'piston_behavior'
2. 'walk_velocity'
3. 'jump_velocity'
4. 'movement_velocity'
5. 'replaceable'
7. 'instrument'
8. 'path_find_through'

# Networking
Add networking supports, the server can synchronize registry to client now, but only items, blocks and entities can be synchronized.

# Others
Performance optimizations.
